name: Gatewatch
description: The Gatewatch is an alliance of planeswalkers sworn by an oath to keep watch against threats to the Multiverse, founded by Gideon, Jace, Nissa and Chandra.

bio.text: The four swore the oath after Zendikar and committed to standing against the Eldrazi and other threats.

citations.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

bio.text: Liliana swore the oath after the fight against Emrakul on Innistrad, planning to use the group, and the Gatewatch became a group of five headquartered in Jace's house.

citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

bio.text: On Kaladesh the Gatewatch sided with the renegades against Tezzeret and the Consulate, and Ajani joined as a fifth member by speaking the oath.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.
"Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

bio.text: They went to Amonkhet to confront Nicol Bolas, who defeated and scattered them.

citations.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.
"Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

bio.text: On Dominaria Gideon gave Teferi the oath, and in the War of the Spark the group renewed its Oaths and accepted Kaya.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

bio.text: Later, Jace called the group to leave on Dominaria, and Karn and the Gatewatch summoned a strike team to New Phyrexia.

citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

citations.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citations.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

status.text: The latest event that shows the Gatewatch has Emrakul allowing it to seal her in the moon of Innistrad, and the story does not say whether the group still operates.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra the Eldrazi sweep seems done, and Chandra insists she is part of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: I'm in this, Gideon. I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that the Gatewatch has no plan for the third titan, Sorin, Nahiri or other threats like the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: these were threats that could only be handled by Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana resolves to treat powerful friends as better zombies and dreams of her own Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: My very own Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
timeline.quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana is now a member of the Gatewatch and sees futures full of promise and ambition.
timeline.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains he has put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.
timeline.quote: I've put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Dovin Baan, a Minister of Inspections from Kaladesh, as the first to seek out the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Our guest is Dovin Baan.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes Baan wants the Gatewatch to provide security and hunt the renegades.
timeline.quote: So, to be clear, you want the Gatewatch to provide...security?

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Baan the Gatewatch handles outside threats, not internal ones, so its hands are tied.
timeline.quote: our hands are tied.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra resolves to find the renegade inventor she believes is in danger, though the Gatewatch does not care.
timeline.quote: Somewhere in this crowd was the renegade she sought

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: On a skiff across the river, Nissa thinks of Ashaya and of her place in the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She thought of Ashaya then, her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch is about not being alone and having a family on any plane.
timeline.quote: Having a family, no matter what plane we're on.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks what the Gatewatch is.
timeline.quote: What's a Gatewatch?

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
timeline.quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
timeline.quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
timeline.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan plans curfews and tighter aether supply to suppress the renegades while the Gatewatch is captured.
timeline.quote: Increased Bastion presence. Curfews, perhaps.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan, having exhausted Kaladesh's resources against a self-described renegade, decides to call on the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Dovin sees no other choice but to reach outside his world and call on other Planeswalkers

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
timeline.quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
timeline.quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia warns that a huge aether turret at the Spire's base can destroy anything that flies and proposes a ground team to take it out.
timeline.quote: "I might have a way to take it out," Pia said.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Ajani to join the Gatewatch, and Ajani speaks the oath.
timeline.quote: "Never again," said Ajani. "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: All the gods approach and Hazoret takes Samut and the Gatewatch to face the last initiates, knocking them out.
timeline.quote: Your time has come

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The dissidents awake in the arena with cartouches of control, and Nissa learns to move against the cartouche by treating it like a leyline.
timeline.quote: They work like leylines

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret orders the initiates to kill the heretics and starts the final Trial, casting her mark of battle rage over everyone.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's mark of battle rage appeared over their heads.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun passes through the horns, a shadow crosses the arena, and the Hours begin.
timeline.quote: It has begun. The Hours have begun!

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh spots Liliana and the Gatewatch arrive, bruised from the arena.
timeline.quote: Liliana saw the rest of the Gatewatch arrive.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon blocks Neheb's spear and the Gatewatch destroy the Eternals; Samut stabs Neheb and kills him.
timeline.quote: She sprinted toward the Eternal minotaur and stabbed him in the back with both khopeshes

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas flies toward the five waiting planeswalkers and reflects on his decades of preparation on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: At the edges of the plaza, five planeswalkers stood arrayed against him

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas lands and roars, judging the Gatewatch's simple kill-the-dragon plan.
timeline.quote: They had chosen kill the dragon .

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teyo, Kaya and Rat discuss the Gatewatch and Teyo admits he has killed only a spider.
timeline.quote: Never heard of 'Gatewatch' before today.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Emrakul allows the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad, waiting until the time is right.
timeline.quote: she willingly allowed the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: As a Gatewatch member, Ajani mentors fellow planeswalkers to help them master their gifts.
timeline.quote: As a member of the Gatewatch, Ajani often provides mentorship to his fellow Planeswalkers

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With the help of the Gatewatch's four founders, the titans Ulamog and Kozilek are destroyed near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
